To train the INDIEVALUEREASONER, we sequentially finetune the Llama-3.1-8B using the OpenInstruct codebase. All models are trained on a single node of 8 NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3 GPUs. Table 16 includes particular hyperparameters we adopt in our experiments. Training on 1 batch of training data takes roughly 0.9 seconds. All evaluations use the checkpoint at the end of epoch 2.

Table 17 shows the detailed specification of baselines and INDIEVALUEREASONER variations used in Table 18 of the main paper.

Below is an example of training data for the INDIEVALUEREASONER.
